definitions.explanation: The quality of being usable in many different situations or for many purposes. Commonly used when evaluating tools, skills, technology, or methods.

examples.japanese: この{道具|どうぐ}は{汎用性|はんようせい}が{高|たか}い。
{汎用性|はんようせい}のある{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{身|み}につけたい。
examples.english: I want to acquire versatile skills.

examples.japanese: このソフトウェアは{汎用性|はんようせい}に{優|すぐ}れており、さまざまな{業種|ぎょうしゅ}で{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: This software excels in versatility and is used across various industries.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in technical, business, and product evaluation contexts. Often appears with {高|たか}い (high) or {低|ひく}い (low) to describe the degree of versatility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汎用性|はんようせい}が{高|たか}い (highly versatile)
- {汎用性|はんようせい}が{低|ひく}い (not very versatile)
- {汎用性|はんようせい}に{優|すぐ}れる (to excel in versatility)
- {汎用性|はんようせい}のある〜 (versatile ~)
